description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests for configuring wireless network settings, including Wi-Fi radio enabled state, WPS setup, MAC filtering, SSID configuration, band steering, and other wireless parameters. It includes external utility scripts and performs various configuration updates based on POST data.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates a WPS PIN checksum based on length and checksum algorithm.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Validates MAC filter parameters for proper printable characters and MAC address format.
